onset.Description: Time in seconds relative to the beginning of the task.

duration.Description: Event duration in seconds. Events are considered instantaneous and therefore have a duration of 0.

Word.Description: Word selected or generated by the participant during the emotional word association task.

Correlation.Description: Semantic similarity score between the current word and the previous word in the participant's response sequence.

NewWord.Description: Indicates whether the participant generated a new word.

Levels.0: Word selected from the suggested options.
